m: ख—खो˚ल्कादित्य m. a form of the sun, SkandaP.

s: puM, (Ke AkASe sUryyarUpeRa Kezu indriyezu AtmarUpeRa ulkA iva । antarvvahiHprakASakatvAt taTAtvam .) sUryyaH । yaTA, -- hariruvAca । “punaH sUryyArccanaM vakzye yaduktaM Bfgave purA । om KaKolkAya om namaH ॥” iti gAruqe 16 aDyAyaH ॥ KazolkAyeti ca pAWaH ॥ (ayaM hi kASIsTitAdityaH । iti kASIKaRqam ॥ yaduktaM tatrEva 50 aDyAye । “KaKolko nAma BagavAnAdityaH parikIrttitaH ॥” etadvivaraRaM tatrEvADyAye viSezato drazwavyam ॥)
v: pu॰ kASIsTe AdityaBede tatkaTA kASI॰ 50 a॰ yaTA “KaKolkonAma BagavAnAdityaH parikIrttataH । tripizwapottare BAge sarvavyADiviGAtakaH । yaTA KaKolkEtyAKyA tasyAdityaKa tacCfRu” ityupakrame “KaKolkA nipatedezA BfSaM gadgadaBAziRI । murcCAM gatavatI pakzapuwA DftvA viloragI । saKyulkA nipatedezA vakavye'pyatisaMBramAt । KaKolketi yaduktA gIH kadravA samBrAntacetasA । tadA KaKolkanAmArkastuto vinatayA bahu” “tapasyantImaTAlokya kadAcidvinatAM praBuH । SivasyEva paromUrttiH KaKalko nAma BAskaraH । dattvA varaM svapApaGnaM SivajYAnasamanvitam । ka SIvAsijanAnekarUpa pApakzayaNkaraH । vinatAditya ityAKyaH KaKelkastatra saMsTitaH । itTaM KaKolka AdityaH kASIviGnatamoharaH । tasya darSanamAtreRa sarvapApEH pramucyate । kASyAM pElaNgile tIrTe KaKolkasya vilokanAt । naraScintitamApnoti nIrAgo jAyate kzaRAt । naraHSrutvEtadAKyAnaM KaKolkAdityasamBavam । garuqeSena sahitaM sarvvapApEH pramucyata” tatrEvADyAyaSeze
m: ख—खोल्क m. ‘sky-meteor’, the sun, SkandaP.; GāruḍaP.
